build_nonautoregressive_wrapper: build a NonAutoregressiveWrapper to train a transformer with non-autoregressive masked language modeling
generate_text_nonautoregressive: generate text sequences using NonAutoregressiveWrapper.generate with iterative mask-unmask sampling
train_generator_critic_losses: train generator and critic losses with NonAutoregressiveWrapper.forward using token critic scoring
create_self_critic_module: create a SelfCritic module that scores sequence quality via embedded logits for non-autoregressive generation
sample_gumbel_with_noise: sample from logits using gumbel_sample with temperature annealing and gumbel noise for discrete sampling
